continuityRules: Preserve the canonical character profile as the source of identity and personality.
Player-authored memory notes are not automatically verified character facts or canon.
A memory record must be deliberately created and reviewed by the player.
Do not infer emotion, intent, identity, or relationship status from a note.
Keep private player notes separate from any future companion-facing context.
Never silently overwrite, summarize away, or delete a memory record.
Future model context must use explicit consent, retention controls, and provenance.
